data.description: High Floor | Largest Layout | Near Circle Mall
data.display_address: Binghatti Azure, District 16, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience smart and comfortable living in this spacious studio apartment in Binghatti Azure, located in the heart of JVC. Positioned on a high floor, this unit features one of the largest layouts in the building, offering 400.63 sqft of well-utilized space with excellent natural light and an open feel.

The apartment is offered unfurnished at AED 50,000, with the option to be furnished at a higher price, making it flexible for both end-users and tenants looking for convenience.

Strategically located near Circle Mall and close to one of the main entrances and exits of JVC, the property ensures easy access in and out of the community—one of the key advantages tenants look for in this area.

Property Features:

* High floor unit
* Largest studio layout (400.63 sqft)
* Unfurnished (furnishing available at higher price)
* Bright and functional layout

Building Amenities:

* Swimming pool
* Fully equipped gym
* Kids pool
* 24/7 security

This unit is ideal for tenants seeking space, accessibility, and value within one of JVC’s most connected locations.
